mapper.sql: cpd.id, cpd.base_currency_id, bc.code AS base_currency_code, cpd.quote_currency_id, qc.code AS quote_currency_code, cpd.forward_precision, cpd.reverse_precision, cpd.created_at, cpd.updated_at
FROM currency_pair_definition cpd JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = cpd.base_currency_id JOIN currency qc ON qc.id = cpd.quote_currency_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE (cpd.base_currency_id = #{currencyIdA} AND cpd.quote_currency_id = #{currencyIdB}) OR (cpd.base_currency_id = #{currencyIdB} AND cpd.quote_currency_id = #{currencyIdA})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_pair_definition (base_currency_id, quote_currency_id, forward_precision, reverse_precision) VALUES (#{baseCurrencyId}, #{quoteCurrencyId}, #{forwardPrecision}, #{reversePrecision})
